BindAxb700.title: 700AXB Intermediary Number – Number Binding
BindAxb700.description:
Before invoking this API, ensure that you have purchased a privacy number in the console.  
You can use this API to attach phone numbers to a 700AXB intermediary number, or alternatively, bind numbers A and B to the 700AXB intermediary number on the Number Management page in the console.  

Before binding numbers to a 700AXB intermediary number, we recommend that you clearly identify the roles of A and B in your business scenario. For example, in a ride-hailing scenario, A represents the passenger role and B represents the driver role.  

The 700AXB intermediary number is primarily used for privacy protection in one-to-one scenarios. Customers establish a binding relationship between numbers A and B through the number privacy service: when A dials X, the call is forwarded to B; when B dials X, the call is forwarded to A. A single X number can be reused across up to 200 distinct binding pairs (for example, A1XB1, A2XB2, A3XB3, ...). As long as the mobile phone numbers of users A and B are not duplicated, one X number can simultaneously bind up to 200 groups of mobile numbers, and calls can occur concurrently.  

Queries per second (QPS) limit  

The QPS limit for this API is 5,000 requests per second per user. If this limit is exceeded, API Calls will be subject to rate limiting, which may impact your service. Please invoke the API appropriately.

*   Ringtone setting (without a callback number) when phone number A is used to call phone number X in the AXN extension binding: AXNRing_A
*   Ringtone setting when phone number N is used to call phone number X in the AXN extension binding: AXNRing_N

*   Ringtone setting (without a callback number) when phone number A is used to call phone number X in the AXG binding: AXGRing_A
*   Ringtone setting when a phone number in number group G is used to call phone number X in the AXG binding: AXGRing_G

You can choose **Number Pool Management** > **Enterprise CRBT Management** to view and manage enterprise CRBT codes. >  The bound enterprise CRBTs are preferentially used. If no enterprise CRBT is set or the setting does not take effect, the enterprise CRBTs at the phone number pool level are used.
